checks.reason: Saving a nonempty note never reaches the required confirmation; the early return inside the completion callback leaves success hidden.

evidence.tool: Playwright 1.64.1 / Chromium 156.0.8078.4; current Codex app inspection
evidence.observation: {"scenario": "flow", "viewport": {"height": 800, "width": 375}, "url": "http://127.0.0.1:35227/index.html", "observations": "{\"empty\":true,\"focus\":\"note\",\"outline\":\"solid\",\"label\":[\"Note text\"],\"error\":true,\"loading\":true,\"success\":false,\"copy\":\"\"}\nCurrent host assessment: Actual keyboard focus reaches the labelled Note text input and has a solid focus outline. Empty submit shows an error and focuses the input. Valid submit shows loading, then no Saved confirmation appears; success=false, copy empty. The completion callback returns before updating success/empty state. This is a reproducible user flow dead end."}
